evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~443 °C, physically implausible vs 60-75 °C column, and jumps 444→453.5→429 in two minutes
Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero/noise throughout, no product takeoff despite FYI702 ~6
Pressure drops flat (~0.6/2.9 mbar) and PY23 steady ~500 mbar, indicating little vapor traffic

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature/heater-duty reading and a flow-totalizer or sight-glass check to confirm whether T701 is a faulty sensor and whether any reflux is actually circulating; plus a distillate composition sample.
